_readme: Live fare config for MeterSmart. Edit + redeploy to change rates without an app update. IMPORTANT: bump 'version' by 1 on every change, otherwise clients ignore the file. Keep it in sync with DEFAULT_RATES in index.html (test-fares.mjs fails if they differ). Luggage is per 20 kg above the first 20 kg, max 50 kg in all (= 2 units). Set lastVerified only on a day someone checked the source.
source: Bengaluru DTA auto fare revision (notified 14 Jul 2025, effective 1 Aug 2025)

complaint._note: Leave blank to let the user pick the recipient. Fill in only with an address/number you have verified as current.
